info.title: iubenda Universal API
info.description: Connect to the iubenda Consent Database HTTP API to manage consents, subjects, legal notices, and consent proof documents.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

subject.description: Subject data for the consent event.

subject.id.description: Subject ID for the consent event.

subject.email.description: Subject email address for the consent event.

subject.firstName.description: Subject first name for the consent event.

subject.lastName.description: Subject last name for the consent event.

subject.fullName.description: Subject full name for the consent event.

subject.verified.description: Whether the consent subject is verified.

subject.phones[].description: Array of phone objects for the consent subject.

subject.phones[].number.description: A phone number with country code prefix for the consent subject.

subject.phones[].label.description: Label used to identify the consent subject phone number.

legalNotices[].description: Legal notices associated with the consent.

legalNotices[].identifier.description: Identifier of a legal notice associated with the consent.

legalNotices[].version.description: Version of the associated legal notice. Auto-filled by iubenda when omitted.

proofs[].description: Proof entries associated with the consent.

proofs[].content.example: Accepted privacy policy from signup form

proofDocumentIds[].description: IDs of documents that provide proof of the consent.

preferences.description: Consent preference values keyed by preference name.

ipAddress.description: IP address associated with the consent event.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at which the consent occurred.
